ActivityFeed.description: Newest first. Pass `next_cursor` as `cursor` for the next page while it is set.

AppInput.description: One entry of `inputs` in an app's template.yaml, as Cargo sends it.

AppRequirements.description: What Cargo's `get_one_click_image_requirements` returns for an app.

DeleteSnapshotsResponse.description: `failed` maps each snapshot that was not deleted to the reason.

ImagePage.description: One page of a region's images. Ask again with `next_offset` while it is set.

OperatorLinks.description: Desk and Atlas form links, shown to operators only.

PlanCatalog.description: The plans a new server can take, grouped by plan family, with the image they apply to.

ReadyApp.description: A ready-to-run application the region's Cargo has built an image of.

ReceivedInvitation.description: A pending invitation addressed to the signed-in user.

Registry.description: A team's servers, self-serve sites and unfinished creations.

ResizeServerResponse.description: `queued` is false when nothing had to change. The action fields come with a queued resize.

SentInvitation.description: One row of a bulk invite. `invitation` is empty and `error` says why when the row was refused.

ServerDetails.description: One server as its page shows it. `operator_links` is set only for staff.

ServerMetrics.description: Usage samples. `points` and `sample_interval_seconds` are present only when `available`.

SnapshotList.description: `server` is set when the list is for one server.

TeamSummary.description: A team the signed-in user can switch to.

TeamTicket.description: `url` is empty for a teammate's ticket, which the portal opens only for the person who raised it.

TicketCategory.description: Pass `key` as `category` and an issue `label` as `issue_type` to `create_ticket`.

WireGuardDevice.description: `added_by_name` and `can_delete` come with the device list.

apiKey.description: `token <api key>:<api secret>`. The caller's own capabilities apply.
apiKey.name: Authorization

info.description: Central is the control plane for Frappe Cloud v2. It owns identity, teams, servers, sites and billing. Send the header `Authorization: token <api key>:<api secret>`. The capabilities of the token's user decide access.
